entities.summary: Talha Mosque or Qubbat Talha, one of the oldest mosques in Sanaa (Yemen), was built by order of the Ottoman Wali Hadji Mehmed Pasha from 1619 to 1620, during the first Ottoman occupation. The minaret was built at the same time.
